title: Writing: A Personal Reflection on Wishes and Regrets

writingModel.placeholder: Opening: describe one moment you wish had been different
writingModel.hint: Use "wish" or "if only" to anchor the regret

writingModel.placeholder: Describe the situation and what actually happened
writingModel.hint: Be specific — when, where, who, what

writingModel.placeholder: Explore the counterfactual: what might have happened
writingModel.hint: Use "if I had…, I would have…" or "supposing I had…"

writingModel.placeholder: Reflect on what you learned or how the experience changed you
End with a forward-looking statement: what you wish for yourself now
writingModel.hint: Use "I wish I could / would" or "from now on, I intend to"

writingTemplate.placeholder: e.g., I had taken more risks in my early twenties
writingTemplate.hint: Start with a clear wish or regret

writingTemplate.placeholder: e.g., I didn't realise how important that decision would be
writingTemplate.hint: Set the context — what was happening then
Link the regret to a hypothetical outcome
writingTemplate.placeholder: e.g., said yes... things would have developed very differently
e.g., I might have discovered a passion I didn't know I had
e.g., I understand now that fear was holding me back
e.g., regret can be a powerful teacher if we let it
writingTemplate.hint: Draw a lesson from the reflection

writingTemplate.placeholder: e.g., I could face such moments with more courage

items: I can't help but wonder what would have happened if…
If I had done X, I might have…
Had I known then what I know now…
What if I had chosen differently?
Imagine how things might have unfolded
Looking back, I can see that…
This shaped me in ways I didn't expect
From now on, I intend to…
I would rather face the fear than wonder what might have been

questions.text: Which is the correct way to start a personal reflection about a past regret?
opts: I wish I will study more.
I wish I had studied more.
I wish I studied more yesterday.
I wish I would study more.
questions.correct: I wish I had studied more.

questions.text: "___ I known what the consequences would be, I would have decided differently." (Formal inverted)
questions.hint: Had + subject + pp = inverted past conditional

questions.text: "Supposing I had taken the other path — where ___ I be now?"
questions.hint: Past hypothetical: "would" in the result clause

questions.text: Complete the reflection phrase: "In ___, I understand that I was not ready for that opportunity."
questions.hint: "In hindsight" = looking back and understanding now

questions.text: Which phrase best introduces a forward-looking wish?
opts: Looking forward, I wish I could…
questions.correct: Looking forward, I wish I could…

questions.text: A personal reflection can combine past regrets with forward-looking wishes in the same piece.
questions.hint: A well-structured reflection moves from past → reflection → forward

questions.text: "The experience ___ me that regret can be a powerful teacher." (= taught)
questions.hint: "The experience taught me that…" — key reflection phrase

questions.text: "I would rather ___ such moments with more courage." (= prefer to face)
